turns.customer: One of the two Beacon 500 headlamps from order #1245 stopped charging after a 3-night trip. Can I return it?
turns.reply:
Thanks for the details. Since the headlamp was already used on your trip, it can't go through a standard return — our return policy only covers unused items in original condition.

The good news: a headlamp that stopped charging after normal use sounds like a manufacturing defect, and our 1-year warranty covers electronics issues like that. Warranty claims are handled by a team member, who may repair, replace, or refund at our discretion. Would you like me to pass this to them? If so, I'll send it over with your order and what happened.
